name: AI Deep Dive — HUT — 2026-05-02
rationale: Hut 8 (HUT) presents a severe capital destruction profile. Trading at an $8.6B valuation on just $15M in trailing revenue, the market is pricing in an impossibly seamless pivot to AI/HPC hosting. The company burned -$787M in free cash flow over the last year, with operating margins collapsing to -2104%. To fund this infrastructure arms race, massive shareholder dilution is inevitable. My weighted fair value of $9.15 implies nearly 90% downside risk from the current $76.98 price.

aiThesis.rationale: Hut 8's valuation is completely decoupled from economic reality. The $8.6B market cap is sustained purely by the AI/HPC infrastructure narrative, yet their execution thus far has resulted in terrifying cash burn (-$787M FCF) and negative gross margins. The capital required to build out gigawatt-scale data centers will force continuous, punishing equity dilution on current shareholders. Even if HUT manages a miraculous 80% CAGR for 5 years and stabilizes margins at 10%, the required 50% dilution suppresses the PV to $8.78. At $76.98, the stock is a dangerous bubble offering zero margin of safety.
